About Ogilvy 

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. Ogilvy UK specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Argos, , Mondelēz International, Unilever, TK Maxx and Pernod Ricard.

The Role:  

An Account Executive provides the solid and essential foundations of the team. Keeping projects on track, fostering enduring and robust relationships with junior clients and internal agency team to make sure every detail is considered from briefing to final execution – you’re the glue that holds the internal team together. 

The ‘go to person’ for both Client and Agency when it comes to co-ordination, and a master of the little things that make all the difference.  

You’ll need to be switched on, full of energy, keen to learn and obsessed with great work. 

Key Responsibilities:  
 

  • Be the client and competitor expert – become the fountain of all knowledge on client mandatories and regulations, be on the lookout for information, articles and new work relating to the clients, the category or the competition 
  • Be the go-to for Junior clients – helping to maintain and strengthen relationships at that level  
  • Be opinionated about the creative – bring your own unique perspective on work to creative reviews, share creative you think is good/interesting with the team, offer ideas on how to work more effectively  
  • Be commercial - Work closely with finance team to ensure all day-to-day account and project finance is managed smoothly  
  • Be the main support for your team – be organised and proactive in thinking about how you can assist internal teams and clients to keep everything running smoothly and to set the right conditions for great work to thrive  
  • Be organised - Ensure guard books, client server files and brand guidelines are kept up to date; own client status meetings and reports – ensuring actions are met; attend meetings and capture notes and clear next steps; support on prepping creative presentations and sense check work with meticulous attention to detail.  
  • Be collaborative – develop great working relationships with all teams internally; support delivery by managing internal reviews & approvals, setting up projects and defining small scopes  
  • Be curious – get to know the craft of advertising, actively read industry press to develop your own sense of what good looks like, ask questions and actively seek out new learning opportunities  
  • Be an Operational Steward: As the team's operational linchpin, you drive daily operations, uphold processes, and maintain alignment for smooth project execution. You partner with the Project Director to develop scopes, fees, timings, and resource allocation, expertly setting up projects on platforms (e.g., Wrike, Workday), orchestrating kick-offs, and aligning internal stakeholders.

  • A meticulous eye for detail and a proactive, problem-solving mindset 
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects  
  • A collaborative approach – to enable you to work closely with creatives, strategists, producers, and clients to bring campaigns to life

description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead Wie ben je? Establish independent assurance, a scalable QMS and a leadership culture in which quality is built into every function. Enable on-time vehicle delivery at the agreed cadence through capable processes, credible readiness evidence and sustained improvement.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Customer quality. Own customer quality relationships, requirements, reviews, audits, complaints and escapes. Work with Mission Launch Operations as the internal customer for launch vehicles to define quality acceptance and handover evidence. Cascade requirements through Engineering, production, AIT and suppliers to raw materials; lead containment, corrective action and feedback.
  • Product assurance. Lead independent mission, project and design assurance from requirements through development, qualification, production and mission readiness. Establish assurance plans and gate evidence covering risks, traceability, interfaces, configuration, verification and validation. Challenge gaps and escalate unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.
  • QMS and compliance. Own the QMS across all business functions, including process controls, records, audits, management review and corrective action. Use AS9100 as the aspirational framework with a proportionate maturity roadmap. Coordinate compliance assurance with Legal and specialist owners, ensuring applicable contractual, regulatory and certification obligations have accountable owners and evidence.
  • Supplier and operational quality. Lead quality assurance across suppliers, manufacturing, Propulsion AIT, Launch Vehicle AIT, engine testing and launch-pad AIT. Establish control plans, traceability and acceptance arrangements. Support current delivery and future product readiness, using AS9145 APQP as guidance.
  • Inspection requirements and quality at source. Through the Chief Inspector, define inspection requirements, techniques and acceptance evidence with Engineering. With Production Engineering and Operations, maximise poka-yoke, automated checks and real-time in-process verification to prevent defects and drive right first time (RFT), reducing reliance on offline inspection. Validate controls against technical requirements; ensure capable methods, calibrated equipment, competent personnel and traceable results, retaining required independent acceptance.
  • Problem solving and learning. Lead disciplined containment, root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant defects and escapes. Verify effectiveness, prevent recurrence and feed lessons from suppliers, builds, tests and missions into design and process improvements.
  • Lean management. Own the business-wide Lean methodology, standards, capability development and maturity assessment. Equip leaders to improve their own functions through daily management, visual performance, standard work and structured problem solving, supported by specialist coaching.
  • Continuous improvement. Govern a prioritised business-wide improvement portfolio aligned with customer outcomes, delivery, quality, lead time and cost. Coordinate cross-functional learning and verify sustained benefits with accountable leaders and Finance.
  • Digital thread and AI. Connect quality and assurance evidence across PLM, ERP, MES, test and mission readiness. Apply AI and automation to analysis, document review, reporting and workflows to improve departmental efficiency, with trusted data, appropriate access controls and accountable human review.

Authority and working relationships

  • Chief Inspector. Reports directly to this role and leads inspection capability and technical practice. Set priorities and assure the suitability of inspection methods, equipment and competence; Engineering retains authority for technical requirements and acceptance criteria.

The Production System / CI Leader reports to VP Spectrum Production with a functional link to this role for methodology, standards, coaching capability and maturity assessment. Manufacturing and AIT leaders own local improvement delivery and sustainment.

Assure their processes and evidence, working with Production Engineering on process readiness, capability and design-for-manufacture feedback.

description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As an Engagement Manager in our Zurich or Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers, and you will be accountable for whether the design survives contact with production.
  • Project Delivery: Run engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Feasibility & Economics: Own the answer to "will this work, and what will it cost". The evaluation approach, the unit economics per query or per case, and the point at which the business case stops closing.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Team Leadership: Lead mixed teams of consultants, data scientists and engineers. You are the person who can tell whether the technical plan is realistic, and the person the client believes when you say that it is.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich and Lausanne offices by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time, and lead a team through both. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field. A strong technical foundation counts for more with us than where you studied.
  • Work Experience: Five to eight years across consulting and technology delivery, including at least one dedicated AI or data project.
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A strong dual affinity for business and technology. You have a deep working understanding of modern data and AI concepts — generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud architectures — and of their practical business applications. You are capable of scoping AI use cases and of discussing technical constraints and opportunities confidently with C-level stakeholders.
  • Technical Depth: You have owned the technical shape of AI work, not only its business case. You think in terms of enterprise architecture — how a solution fits the existing landscape, what it needs from data and governance, and how it scales from pilot to full rollout — and can defend those choices to technical and commercial stakeholders alike. You will not be writing production code, but you should have been close enough to it to be credible with the engineers with which you will collaborate.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You can take a technical trade-off to a non-technical sponsor without flattening it, and be challenged by an engineer without retreating into abstraction. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

 

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat. We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op! Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen. Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt. Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied; gaat werken met grote databases (SQL); kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders; analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten. Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein: - Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes. - Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering. - Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes. - Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten. - Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen. - Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten. Wat vragen we van jou? - Wo werk- en denkniveau. - Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen. - Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling. - Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren. - Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen. - Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam. - Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop. - Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré. - Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Databricks is seeking multiple Lakebase Sales Specialists (Central) to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

This role is based in Munich, Germany (flexible within Germany for the right candidate), and will cover customers in the Central region (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe).

The impact you will have

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

  1. Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
  2. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
  3. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.
  4. Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.
  • Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).
  • Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.
  • Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.
  • Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.
  • Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.
  • Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.
  • Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. description:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to own the technical direction of a data engagement, working with AWS data services, platforms like Snowflake and Databricks, Python, and PySpark across our data team. You’ll lead a team of data engineers, setting the standards for how pipelines and architecture are designed, built, and operated, while staying hands-on with the most complex technical challenges. You’ll work closely with client stakeholders and CreateFuture’s wider engineering capability to make sure delivery is both technically excellent and commercially sound.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the technical direction of a data engagement, setting standards for pipeline architecture, data modelling, orchestration, testing, and operational readiness
  • Lead and technically direct a team of data engineers, allocating work, reviewing designs and code, and unblocking technical challenges
  • Design and evolve data platform architecture on AWS (e.g. AWS Glue, EMR, S3/Lake Formation, Redshift, Athena) alongside platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, weighing trade-offs in performance, cost, and maintainability
  • Set and enforce CI/CD, testing, observability, and operational practices across the engagement’s data engineering workflows
  • Build professional relationships with key client stakeholders, translating business and data requirements into a coherent technical roadmap, with clear estimates, trade-offs, and risks
  • Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex issues in live data pipelines, and lead incident response when things go wron

We'd love to talk to you if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience designing and operating production data platforms on a modern cloud data stack such as AWS (Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3/Lake Formation), Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable, and can articulate which architectural decisions travel between platforms and which don’t
  • Have deep SQL expertise and a strong grasp of data modelling and architecture (Kimball, data vault, medallion/lakehouse patterns, or domain modelling). This is the clearest line between someone who operates a platform and someone who can design on top of it, and it’s provider-agnostic
  • Have owned orchestration strategy in production, including dependency design, retries, SLAs, and the observability that tells you a pipeline failed before the client does
  • Have designed ingestion from awkward sources (APIs, CDC off operational databases, files that change shape without warning) and set patterns your team can reuse
  • Have strong proficiency in Python and PySpark for batch/ELT processing at scale, with production-grade, well-tested code. The bulk of this work is batch and ELT, but you’ll have experience with event-driven or micro-batch pipelines and know where the design assumptions stop holding
  • Have led or technically directed a team of data engineers, setting standards for pipeline design, testing, and delivery, and growing the engineers around you
  • Have owned CI/CD and operational practices for data engineering workflows across a team or engagement
  • Are experienced working directly with client stakeholders, building trust, shaping solutions from ambiguous requirements, and challenging where appropriate

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Senior Director, Market Access, EU Center and work closely with Medical Affairs, HEOR, Regulatory, Commercial and our global Market Access team to secure and sustain patient access to BridgeBio’s medicines across the DACH region. Your remit is to own the German AMNOG process end to end – from the value dossier under § 35a SGB V through the reimbursement price negotiation with the National Association of Statutory Health Insurance Funds (GKV-Spitzenverband) under § 130b SGB V – and regional market access, which turns that outcome into real-world access through direct engagement with sickness funds, the Medical Service, regional physicians’ associations, hospitals and treating centres. You will also lead reimbursement submissions in Austria and Switzerland. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep AMNOG and HTA expertise with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead AMNOG value dossiers end to end: plan, resource, quality-assure and submit complete dossiers under § 35a SGB V to the Federal Joint Committee (G-BA), including derivation of the appropriate comparator therapy (zVT), early identification of evidence gaps and defensible argumentation on indirect comparisons, surrogate and subgroup analyses
  • Own G-BA and IQWiG interactions: prepare scientific advice requests under § 8 AM-NutzenV, run written commenting procedures and oral hearings, and manage all procedural communication and timelines
  • Prepare and support price negotiations: develop pricing strategy, negotiation mandate, scenarios and European reference price analyses for the negotiation with the GKV-Spitzenverband under § 130b SGB V, and plan realistically for arbitration board risk

  • Resolve access barriers in the field: handle individual reimbursement requests, denials and claw-backs together with Medical Affairs and the field teams, and turn recurring issues into argumentation aids and training material
  • Extend access beyond Germany: lead reimbursement submissions in Austria (EKO) and Switzerland (FOPH Specialities List), and bring market access requirements into study design, evidence planning and launch planning across the cross-functional team

Where You’ll Work 

  • This is a Germany-based remote role

description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for a Fullstack Engineer to help develop and scale the Lightning AI platform across the frontend, CLI, APIs, and core backend systems. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key features and drive them end-to-end, working closely with engineering, product, and design to ship high-quality, iterative improvements. This is an opportunity to build systems that support real-world machine learning workloads at scale.

This role is based in one of our hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with a minimum of 2 in-office days per week and occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You’ll Do

  • Write readable/testable/efficient code in React and either Python or Go (Golang).
  • Build deep expertise in our technology stack to deliver new features, improve system stability, and increase overall performance.
  • Partner with engineering and product leaders on developing the Lightning product while using your experience to set the technical direction for large projects.
  • Evaluate, strengthen, and document technical architecture, tools, and processes.
  • Maintain high standards for software quality, implement automation, drive continuous delivery, and reduce time to production while proactively reducing technical debt.
  • Mentor and coach engineers on system design, operating in high uncertainty, and problem-solving to create a supportive, inclusive environment where each engineer can grow.

What You’ll Need

  • Proficiency in React and either Go (Golang) or Python, with a preference for Go
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and lifecycle
  • Hands-on experience as a Fullstack Engineer in a SaaS technology company
  • Proven ability to take ownership of key features and drive end-to-end development
  • Communication and collaboration with engineers, product managers, and designers
  • Ability to operate in high uncertainty and rapidly changing environments

 

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:
$120,000—$250,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).
  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.
  • Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.
  • Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.
  • Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.
  • In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents. De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués. Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran. Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées. description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Position Overview

As a member of the World Wide Strategic Accounts field team, the Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a senior technologist who owns the technical sales strategy, evaluation program, and architectural vision creating repeatable business with software opportunities with the company’s largest multinational customers. You will guide C‑level and engineering stakeholders through solution discovery, validation, and financial justification, ensuring every engagement results in a technical win and a clear path to enterprise‑wide adoption that delivers the customers business outcomes aligned to the project. Driving Everpure as the standard solution for delivering data-management in the WWSA Segment. Creating market penetration strategy and thought leadership across the entire theater/segment.

The role of a Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a multifaceted position that serves as a technical bridge between the sales, product, and engineering teams. This role is important for driving revenue growth and enhancing customer relationships by providing technical solutions for a specific set of accounts. Primarily focused on the pre-sales process, the individual in this role will engage with potential and existing customers to understand their business issues and technical hurdles related to Kubernetes. They will deliver tailored product demonstrations, respond to technical inquiries, and work with the Everpure technical field to architect solutions that integrate Everpure offerings with clients' software driven platforms. The responsibilities of the Cloud Native Architect will fall into (5) categories:

  • Participation in Lead Generation
  • Technical Qualification
  • Solution Validation
  • Prospect to Customer Transition
  • Established Customer Satisfaction

These categories will serve not only as the foundation for the role, but align with the Technical Sales Process to provide the best possible customer experience.

Role Scope

Theater: Strategics (EMEA)

Builds and leads: CNA team pooled to deliver outcomes in aligned theater Strategic accounts

Role type: Technical Pre-sales Architect

Revenue alignment:

  • This role is directly assigned to the Theater Strategics Portworx and Pure Storage Cloud quota and is expected to meet and exceed TCV Sales goals.
  • CNAs have primary vertical/account assignments while also being goaled on overall Theater quota performance, ensuring the team operates as a focused unit without losing shared accountability.

Focus Areas & Key Responsibilities

  1. Technical Sales Leadership
    • Lead the full Cloud Native technical sales process life‑cycle, Discovery, Strategy Alignment, Demo, Workshop, POC/POV, and Wrap‑Up to secure the technical decision in deals for WWSA.
    • Architect Kubernetes‑centric data platforms spanning multiple regions, clouds, and business units.
    • Own the technical sections of proposals, RFx responses, and SOWs.
    • Written and verbal fluency in French as well as English is mandatory.

Financial & Business Value Selling

  • Translate technical capabilities into quantified business outcomes that resonate with executive sponsors.

Customer Engagement

  • Act as the primary technical face of the company’s Cloud Native portfolio to WWSA teams; orchestrate executive briefings, architecture workshops, and steering‑committee updates. Locating and coordinating with other BU and technical sales stakeholders to deliver outcomes for customers goals.
  • Establish a cadence (weekly checkpoints, executive QBRs) aligned to the customer’s program milestones. For NNL and Expansion opportunities.

Thought Leadership

  • Evangelize best practices in Cloud Native data management, platform engineering, and cost optimization through conference talks, blogs, and executive roundtables.
  • Mentor fellow Cloud Native Architect (CNA) on enterprise engagement methodology and financial value selling.

Co-Seller Collaboration and Leadership

  • Interact with the WWSA Sales Global Account Manager, Lead Client Director for each strategic account to bring full Pure Storage portfolio solutions to customers
  • Enablement of Cloud Native Processes, standards and excellence.
  1. Lead Generation:
    • Attend industry events to deliver a talk or support booth staff
    • Produce technical content in the form of blogs, webinars and podcasts
    • Proactively engage contacts in professional network through LinkedIn etc
    • Support monthly Hands-on Labs
    • Attend Pure user groups
    • Organize community user groups
    • Attend co-seller Sales Engineering Manager/Directors team meetings monthly to reinforce alignment, share relevant insights, and ensure consistent technical messaging across teams.
      • Bi-Weekly Interactions should focus on meaningful changes in opportunity status, emerging risks, customer sentiment, deal velocity, and where technical leadership can improve outcomes or remove friction.
      • Quarterly Interactions should support shared planning and reflection, including QBR/QSR collaboration, headwinds and tailwinds, participation effectiveness, and alignment on priorities for the coming quarters.
    • Collaborate with the Co-seller Technical Sales Directors to co-sponsor targeted PX sales efforts for a small number of priority customers, engaging directly where technical leadership can materially influence outcomes.
    • Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership
  2. Technical Qualification: 
    • Review information gathered as part of Sales Stage 1
    • Discuss the opportunity with the AE to identify missing data related to BANT and/or other qualifiers.
    • Capture the project success criteria from the customer
    • Create a mapping to the desired Business Impact & Outcomes
    • Review & document the customers current state
    • Document technical pain points & focus areas
    • Review the Assessment Scorecard to ensure alignment with the customer
    • Document the technical details and other data points in SFDC
    • Present the proposed Evaluation Program, based on information gathered from the discovery phase:
      • An overview of their current architecture
      • Review of Pure Storage Capabilities critical to the customer and their project
      • A proposed solution including an updated architecture with Pure Storage data management and key components
      • Success criteria for the proposed solution and method to demonstrate (demo, workshop, POC/POV)
    • Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership
  3. Solution Validation:
    • Provide a capabilities demonstration to the prospect
    • Conduct an Technical Workshop with the prospect to gather deeper solution configuration parameters, discuss additional benefits, and highlight specific solution capabilities
    • Plan and coordinate a Proof Of Concept/Value that will address the customers outstanding solution parameters
    • Provide a POC/POV outcomes report that highlights the testing completed as part of the POC/POV, the relevant outcomes, and the overall business value to the customer.
    • Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership
  4. Prospect to Customer Transition:
    • Introduce & explain fixed scope installation services
    • Coordinate scoping of Professional Services (if needed)
    • Discuss the value of BCS (Business Critical Services) and propose
    • Discuss the value of SA (Solution Architect) Hours and propose
    • Discuss the value of a CSM (Customer Success Manager) and propose
    • Discuss customer training/certification credits and propose
    • Prepare Transition Documentation:
      • High-level Project Plan
      • Key Milestones
      • Customer Key Technical Contacts
      • External Integration Overview
        1. Observability 
        2. Identity Management
        3. Security Requirement
        4. Any additional Integrations
        5. 5. Other dependencies to begin the project (Hardware, Platform, etc.)
    • Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership
  5. Established Customer Satisfaction:
    • Establish a regular cadence beginning 90 days post deal close and continuing quarterly
    • Review product expansion and feature adoption as part of quarterly cadence
    • Document RFEs and usability concerns
    • Provide release updates and updated roadmaps
    • Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership

Expected Impact & Success Metrics

  • Deliver Technical Wins that Convert to Booked Revenue
    • 80% Technical Win rate in Opportunities above Stage 2(Exception for Misaligned Deals)
    • Achieve booked sales attainment goal
  • Accuracy and Accelerated Technical Sales Process
    • Qualified Opportunities with TSP Cycle less than 90 days in Stage 2
  • Technical and Financial Solution Delivery
    • 100% of Opportunities have TCO/ROI proposals with written customer approval
  • Strengthen CX Handoff and Post Close Won Customer Relationship
    • Measure first‑year adoption of features validated during the Technical Sales Process. Document customer progress with CSM.
    • Quarterly meets with every current customer 
  • WWSA Penetration
    • Pool Goal of raising Under penetrated WWSA accounts to over $1M TCV
    • Pool Goal of Pipeline in 50% of WWSA 
    • Pool Goal of initial landing footprint in 50% of WWSA

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Start: ab sofort | Level: Intermediate | Location: Schweiz, remote | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche) 

In der Rolle als Marketing Manager (gn), übernimmst du die Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Markenstrategie für More Nutrition in der Schweiz.

More Nutrition macht bereits 8-stellige Umsätze in der Schweiz, die wir gemeinsam mit dir auf 9-stellige Umsätze ausweiten wollen. 

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du wirkungsvolle Kampagnen, treibst lokale Marketinginitiativen voran und stellst ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis über alle Touchpoints hinweg sicher. Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams, Agenturen und lokalen Akteuren zusammen, um unsere Präsenz auf dem Schweizer Markt massiv auszubauen. 

 

Deine Mission bei uns 

  • Als Brand Guardian entwickelst und setzt du die Markenstrategie für die Schweiz um, indem du globale Leitlinien mit lokalen Consumer Insights verknüpfst
  • Du definierst den Marketing-Aktivierungskalender und leitest die Planung sowie Umsetzung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Massenmedien, Influencer Marketing, TikTok und Point of Sale)
  • Du gestaltest das lokale Produktportfolio basierend auf den Bedürfnissen und Potenzialen des Schweizer Marktes mit
  • Du briefst und steuerst Agenturen zur Erstellung markenkonformer, lokal relevanter Assets (in Deutsch und Französisch) und stellst eine termingerechte Kampagnenumsetzung sicher
  • Du trackst Markenmetriken (Awareness, Equity, Engagement) sowie Kampagnen-KPIs und nutzt diese Daten für eine kontinuierliche Optimierung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit crossfunktionalen Teams zusammen, um ein konsistentes Markenerlebnis im D2C-Bereich, Pureplay und am Point of Sale zu garantieren
  • Du stimmst dich eng mit den lokalen Commercial-Teams ab, um die Marketingaktivitäten perfekt auf die Markt- und Vertriebsziele auszurichten

 

Deine Erfahrung & Skills 

  • Du bringst 4–6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung als Brand- oder Marketing Manager im FMCG- / Konsumgüterbereich mit. Gerne aus dem Bereich Food & Beverage 
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Führung oder Betreuung einer oder mehrerer Marken in der Schweiz mit Umsätzen von mindestens 50 Mio. CHF
  • Du besitzt fundierte Erfahrung in der Steuerung eines D2C-Business sowie in der Steuerung von Omnichannel-Kampagnen (inkl. Mass Media, Influencer Marketing, Social Media wie TikTok und Meta, sowie Point of Sale + Pureplay)
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine starke Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement und echte Lust auf crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit aus
  • Du hast ein strategisches, kreatives und datengetriebenes Mindset und gehst sicher mit digitalen Marketing-Tools um
  • Du hast verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (Schweizerdeutsch) sowie fließende Französischkenntnisse und nutzt Englisch sicher für unsere interne Kommunikation

 

Warum wir? 

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

 

Über uns 

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.  

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and familiarity with scientific and clinical data with commercial curiosity, to turn networks of complex data into meaningful insights. In doing so, the successful candidate will help us better understand where high-value, tractable drug development opportunities exist across our internal pipeline of drug targets, and more broadly across a range of disease areas. Together with other members of the drug development team, this role will help focus which indications, patient segments, and development paths we should consider, and where data can help inform our investment and planning decisions.

This role could be based in our UK or US office and will report to the Chief Development Officer.

Responsibilities: 

  • Across a range of disease/therapeutic areas, build a deep understanding of addressable markets, industry landscape, customer (health care practitioner, payor, and patient) needs, and forecast future states and opportunities for growth in sectors of interest
  • Carry out market sizing, competitive analysis using epidemiology, clinical, and commercial data sets, and validate through research with external experts
  • Partner with clinical, drug development and external experts/customers to further validate specific market segments and develop target product profiles (TPPs)
  • Partner with Finance, Business development, and Drug Development teams to develop asset and disease area valuation models (e.g., rNPV) and support BD and finance discussions with valuation and commercial forecast models as required
  • Design and improve data models, analytical frameworks, and output formats, that support assessments, presentation to stakeholders and internal decision-making
  • Develop dashboards, reporting, and analysis tools to communicate outputs and disease area strategy. Develop and maintain revenue forecasts, pipeline models, and scenario analyses.  
  • Prototype, test, and help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and other analytical resources to support all the above analyses; working with end users and internal teams to refine successful solutions
  • Provide insights to drug development, project management, and finance teams to support target-setting and internal development planning.

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in health sciences discipline or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience working in or with pharmaceutical or biotech companies (including via consulting firms) in product planning or commercial strategy teams
  • Experience in at least one of these disease segments: Cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, oncology, autoimmune diseases
  • Familiarity with drug development strategy and regulatory pathways
  • Experience with a range of healthcare or life-sciences databases and market research tools
  • Exposure to valuation, business development, licensing, or investment analysis
  • Strong analytical and research skills
  • Familiarity with and ability to synthesize scientific, medical, and economic data
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently yet collaboratively, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines

Desirable

  • MD, PhD, or other advanced degree
  • 4-6+ years of industry experience
  • Knowledge of genomic-based approaches to drug target discovery

Values and Behaviors:

  • Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence
  • Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source
  • Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, meaningful exchanges that enhance mutual growth and understanding in all interactions
  • Use a company-first mindset to guide decision-making; prioritize team over individual success
  • Take calculated risks and challenge convention in the quest for exceptional outcomes

About Quotient:

Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs. 

The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end Marketing sourcing: supplier market mapping, RFx execution, negotiation, and contract award for high-value projects

What you’ll bring

  • Minimum 5+ years experience in Marketing procurement or in Marketing with a commercial focus
  • Deep knowledge of strategic sourcing methodology, category management, and supplier management
  • Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and drive to working independently
  • Proven track record of taking ownership: identifying problems early and driving resolution independently, without waiting to be directed
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparing and delivering presentations and reports for senior audience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with proven ability to build trust and credibility with business partners at different levels
  • Able to work in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment
  • Fluent Business English

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.

  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines. What you'll do You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation. Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny. Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality figures, panels and supporting narrative, extending to posters, presentations or manuscripts where relevant. What we're looking for We are looking for someone who's comfortable working on complex biological questions across different therapeutic areas and drug development programs. You will own analysis and interpretation. The ideal candidate is creative, driven, fast, rigorous and autonomous. You will be tackling complex internal R&D subjects that are actively slowing down cancer research. Your findings will impact the field and your work is expected to reach leading scientists via international conferences and peer-reviewed papers. Must have PhD in Computational Biology, bioengineering or any related field, 2 to 3 years analyzing complex biological data in a research or biotech setting is a plus. Strong experience with molecular data: You analyse omics data (transcriptomics, genomics) within the context of cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening… Interdisciplinary mindset: You quickly understand the context and framework within teams outside of your area of expertise. You are comfortable working in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, lab-based scientists and engineers. Structured communication: You communicate research findings clearly through well-documented code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations. For example, you can highlight key figures or publications where you drove the computational biology. Real interest in cancer biology: You don't need to arrive as an expert: there's considerable depth around you and you'll absorb a great deal of it. But you should find the cancer biology genuinely interesting, and be the sort of person who goes the extra mile to understand what happens behind the result. Strong programming skills: Python and fluency in the scientific coding stack. Fluent in English: We are an interdisciplinary and multicultural team working in English. Nice to have Strong experience working with experimentalists. Comfortable holding two or three analyses in parallel without losing track of either. Experience in working with or analyzing data generated from sophisticated patient-derived cellular models (e.g. PDOs, PDXOs). Industry experience where your analyses fed real go/no-go decisions. What we offer Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research. Role: be in a high-impact research role at the core of a distinctive oncology discovery platform, where you will have access to rare PDO multi-omics and functional datasets, and a dedicated engineering counterpart to turn your methods into durable building blocks. Impact: participate and have ownership in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project at the early stage of a growing start-up, with the opportunity to shape it; a role where your technical expertise will have a tangible impact on patient outcomes. Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission. Interview Process HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.
