description:
Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  • Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
  • Work Experience: Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. 
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.
  • Technical Depth: You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

description: Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen. Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist. In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings. Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft. Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab. Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen. Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail. Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz. Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

Location: London (In office presence required 1-2 days a week)

About the Team:

The Customer Success organisation is composed of four teams: pre-sales, customer success managers, account management and support. The CS org is dedicated to ensuring every client realises the full value of their investment in our platform, working as an integrated partner to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes and embed AlphaSense into their everyday decision-making.

By blending industry knowledge, product expertise, and a deep understanding of client priorities, the team helps organisations uncover new use cases, accelerate adoption, and sustain long-term growth. Their close engagement with clients also creates a powerful feedback loop—informing product innovation, shaping content strategy, and ensuring that the evolving needs of the corporate community are consistently reflected in how AlphaSense delivers value.

About the Role: 

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) at AlphaSense, you will be the strategic lead for our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate sector. You are responsible for navigating multi-million dollar global organisations and driving long-term ROI through technical group/individual training while ensuring company-wide adoption across multiple business units. You will manage a concentrated portfolio of strategic accounts, remaining at the forefront of product and Corporate vertical expertise, while scaling your impact across the organisation through account strategy, leadership and innovation.

  • Strategic Account Influence: Navigate and influence multiple business units and key power users across the world largest and most complex global organisations. Create a groundswell of positive user sentiment to drive renewals and expansion with Senior Leadership.
  • Architect Deep Adoption & Value Realization: Synthesise complex usage into actionable insights. Design multi-quarter adoption roadmaps in tandem with your Account Management peers that align AlphaSense capabilities with business objectives.
  • Onboarding & Ongoing Training: As an expert on the product, you will guide new clients through onboarding, training, and best-practice adoption to ensure a strong foundation, both virtually and in person.

  • Executive Presence & Communication: Command virtual and in-person rooms with executive presence, and leverage powerful, strategic follow-ups as a tool to drive adoption and link AlphaSense to specific Senior Leader business objectives.
  • Solo On-Site Leadership: Fully own high-stakes, multi-day on-site engagements and lead customer "Lunch & Learns,’’ tailoring presentations to diverse user groups and core personas using our WWH (Why, What, How) framework.
  • Company Innovation: engage in cross-functional initiatives outside the standard CSM scope, such as product feedback loops, hiring committees, mentorship programs and process innovation to improve team efficiency.

  • 4 -6+ years of professional experience in Customer Success or Account Management, with a proven track record of managing a strategic portfolio. 
  • Recognised as a "Vertical Expert". 
  • Ability to travel 20% of time. 
  • Possess the technical acumen to navigate complex conversations around data integrations, APIs, and AI-driven market intelligence solutions.
  • Ability to identify the 5% of users who drive the majority of sentiment and influence within an account, focusing on high-level business outcomes over basic feature adoption.
  • Excellent communication skills with a demonstrable track record for collaborating internally in a cross-functional environment and onsite with customers. 
  • A natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is committed to contributing to the "AlphaSense Playbook" through mentorship and internal innovation.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Perception and AI team is responsible for how STARK's unmanned systems perceive their surroundings and know where they are. We are a multidisciplinary group of software and navigation engineers developing perception and navigation algorithms for resource-constrained platforms. As a member of this team, you will collaborate closely with sensor, autonomy and test engineers in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Together, we make sure our systems navigate and operate reliably in contested environments, even when GNSS is not available.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Radar Signal Processing Engineer at STARK, you will lead the development of our radar processing chain: turning raw sensor data into reliable 3D detections, in real time, on embedded hardware. Your ultimate goal is to deliver radar measurements that our navigation and mapping algorithms can depend on in the most demanding conditions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

- Design and implement the full radar processing chain: range-Doppler processing, angle estimation and detection.
- Develop robust clutter suppression, multipath mitigation and detection methods for changing terrain, vegetation and weather.
- Deliver 3D detections with Doppler and quality metrics, and define the measurement interface with our radar navigation engineers.
- Evaluate radar sensors with our sensors team and integrate your work with embedded software, autonomy and test teams.
- Take algorithms from Python/MATLAB prototypes to production C++ on embedded compute, and analyse field data to characterise performance and failure modes.
- Constantly challenge requirements and take ownership of radar signal processing as a capability at STARK.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

- You have taken a radar processing chain from raw ADC data to detections on real hardware, not only in simulation.
- Deep understanding of radar signal processing range-Doppler processing, direction-of-arrival estimation, detection theory, clutter â€” and of the underlying radar physics.
- Strong C++ for real-time systems; Python or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis.
- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Physics or a comparable field.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.
- Citizenship of a NATO member state.

NICE TO HAVE

- MIMO radar and array processing
- Radar on moving platforms, including ego-motion compensation
- Embedded acceleration (GPU, SIMD, FPGA)
- Learning-based radar detection or classification
- ROS2 and experience with field testing

Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++ (will consider experience with C++ on macOS or Linux).
  • Strong knowledge of C, C++, and assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences

    • Having grit

  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

What We're Looking For

The Training & Experimentation team at Lightning AI builds the platform that enables developers to experiment at scale and train their own intelligence. Whether customers are training foundation models, fine-tuning open-source models, launching distributed training jobs, or iterating on experiments, this team creates the infrastructure and developer experience that powers every stage of the AI lifecycle.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design and scale the backend systems that make AI development faster, more reliable, and easier to use. You'll work across distributed training infrastructure, workload orchestration, experiment management, developer tooling, and platform APIs while partnering closely with our Managed Infrastructure, Core Platform, and Optimized Compute teams.

This is an opportunity to build systems that support real-world AI workloads at scale while shaping the developer experience used by researchers, startups, and enterprise AI teams around the world.

This role is based in one of our San Francisco, NYC, or London office hubs, with a minimum of 2 in-office days per week and occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build backend services that power AI agent orchestration and execution.
  • Develop scalable APIs and platform capabilities for tool use, workflow orchestration, memory, and state management.
  • Build reliable infrastructure that enables long-running, distributed AI workflows.
  • Partner with product, research, and platform engineering teams to bring new agent capabilities into production.
  • Improve platform reliability, observability, and performance as customer workloads continue to scale.
  • Evaluate and strengthen technical architecture, engineering processes, and developer tooling.
  • Maintain high standards for software quality through testing, automation, continuous delivery, and proactive management of technical debt.
  • Mentor engineers on system design, distributed systems, and backend engineering best practices

 

What You’ll Need

  • Extensive experience building scalable backend systems using Go, Python, Rust, or similar languages.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, APIs, and cloud-native application architecture.
  • Experience designing and operating production services at scale.
  • Hands-on experience building backend platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure products.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and container technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of large technical initiatives from architecture through production.
  • Commitment to software quality, automated testing, observability, and continuous delivery.

Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.

The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

As a Staff ML Engineer, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 

Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).

  • Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 
  • Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop.

description: Our story: Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity At Taxfix, we have made tax filing simpler for millions of people. You will work directly with our Chief Operating Officer to explore, validate and build a new product proposition from the ground up. At Taxfix, AI is part of how we work and build—not just something we talk about. You will use AI tools hands-on to move faster from idea to evidence and from evidence to action. Build the business case: Develop pricing and unit-economics models, assess commercial viability and map the operational requirements for launch and scale. Turn ideas into tangible experiments: Use AI-native and no-code tools to create early prototypes, landing pages or other practical tests. Learn from the results and iterate with the COO and relevant teams. Shape the go-to-market plan: Explore positioning, distribution, regulatory considerations and how to build on Taxfix’s brand and capabilities. Communicate for decisions: Combine research, data and insights into clear recommendations, concise memos and presentations for the COO, Leadership Team and Board. Work AI-first and responsibly: Use approved AI tools to support research, analysis, prototyping and everyday workflows. Check outputs and sources critically, protect sensitive information and involve the right colleagues when needed. Academic collaboration If you are completing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, we encourage you to explore combining the internship with your thesis. Your work could inform real strategic decisions, with access to C-level perspectives and relevant company insights, subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements. Who you are Entrepreneurial and hands-on: You are excited by building something from zero to one, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to take ownership rather than wait for a playbook. AI-native builder mindset: You are familiar with generative AI tools and use them—or are keen to use them—to research, analyze, prototype and automate. You enjoy turning ideas into tangible outputs; you do not need to be a software engineer. Critical thinker: You know that AI can accelerate your work but does not replace judgment. You question assumptions, verify outputs and can explain your reasoning. Structured and analytical: You can break down a broad question into hypotheses and practical workstreams. You are comfortable using Excel for analysis and modelling and PowerPoint to communicate a clear story. Curious and commercially minded: You enjoy understanding customers and connecting their needs to pricing, economics and a viable business model. Strong communicator: You can share ideas clearly and confidently with colleagues and senior stakeholders in German and English. Eager to learn: You are pursuing or have recently pursued a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in business or a related field, and are motivated to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment. What we offer C-level mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain first-hand exposure to executive decision-making. Real ownership: Contribute to building a new proposition, not just supporting a predefined process. Accelerated learning: Gain experience across strategy, product, commercial, operations and venture building. A strong network: Collaborate with Taxfix leaders and connect with our network of founders and investors. An international environment: Join a dynamic team in Berlin with a flexible hybrid setup. A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals. Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible. Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions. Have a four-legged friend in your life? description:
In een notendop

Picnic is een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Europa. Als moderne melkboer maken we elke dag duizenden klanten blij met hun boodschappen. Dat doen we verser, goedkoper en groener dan anderen. Onze klanten doen boodschappen en plannen hun maaltijden in onze app en vervolgens bezorgen wij alles gratis thuis. Zonder omweg via de winkel, in elektrische autootjes, met een grote glimlach.
Toch is onze website minstens zo belangrijk. Het is dé plek waar we nieuwe klanten naar de app trekken. En daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig! Als Copywriter Werkstudent schrijf je heldere, wil-ik-verder-lezen-webteksten: van pagina’s die onze diensten uitleggen tot tips-en-trickspagina’s en zo nu en dan wat SEO.

De kunst van het vak

  • Webcopy: Je schrijft teksten waar je zelf op zou doorklikken. Van pagina’s over onze diensten tot recepttips en inspirerende verhalen over onze makers.
  • De juiste toon: Die weet jij wel te vinden. Want hallo, een tekst over paasrecepten vraagt om iets heel anders dan een verhaal over onze nieuwste appfunctie.
  • Samenwerken: Je spart graag met collega’s, maar gaat net zo graag zelf op onderzoek uit. Samen maken jullie onze website steeds een beetje beter. 
  • Blijven leren: Je leert van ervaren copywriters, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en ontdekt gaandeweg wat een webtekst écht goed maakt.

Over jou...

  • Je volgt een opleiding in bijvoorbeeld communicatie, journalistiek, media of creative writing.
  • Je schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en wordt blij van taal, woorden en zinnen die precies kloppen. Spreek je ook nog ein bisschen Duits? Dat is een plus!
  • Je vindt het leuk om langere teksten te schrijven en maakt complexe informatie graag behapbaar.
  • Je hebt gevoel voor structuur: je weet hoe je een tekst logisch opbouwt en online prettig leesbaar maakt.
  • Je hebt gevoel voor humor, al vind je het wat ongemakkelijk om dat over jezelf te zeggen.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen.

Picnic perks 

🥗Verse lunch, koffie en snacks

Op kantoor hebben we een koffiebar met eigen barista's, chefs die dagelijks een heerlijke, verse lunch bereiden en snacks en fruit zodat je energie op pijl blijft!

✍🏼 Learning & development 

Bij Picnic krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Werk je liever aan je mentale welzijn? Via OpenUp krijg je gratis toegang tot professionele psychologen en diverse trainingen.

💰Aantrekkelijk pakket

Je ontvangt een bruto uurloon van €16.75 (incl. vakantiegeld), samen met een laptop en telefoon om je werk te ondersteunen. Afhankelijk van je woonplaats kunnen ook je reiskosten worden vergoed.

description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join our team at the intersection of international trade, export control, and day-to-day operations at STARK. You will work closely with colleagues from various departments, including Sales, Purchasing, and Logistics. From day one, you will work on real cases and gain practical experience in a fast-paced international environment.

YOUR MISSION

As a Working Student in Export Control, you will support us in reliably integrating national and international export control regulations into our daily business processes. You will work closely with various departments, including Sales, Purchasing, and Logistics, and assist with specific questions regarding export licenses, sanctions, goods classifications, and country-specific restrictions. You will gain direct insight into real cases involving international trade and export control law and have the opportunity to apply your theoretical knowledge directly in practice.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • You will answer daily questions from departments such as Sales, Purchasing, and Logistics regarding export control processes and verification steps.
  • You will actively support the preparation and drafting of export license applications to the Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control (BAFA).
  • Before planned exports, you will conduct research on export licenses, sanctions, goods classifications, and country-specific restrictions.
  • You will analyze and document historical export and customs data for risk analysis and preparation for internal and external audits.
  • You will independently prepare, review, and manage end-use declarations for customers, suppliers, and authorities.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • You are currently enrolled as a student (all genders) in Business Law, Law, Business Administration, Logistics, International Business, or a comparable field.
  • You have a basic understanding of or strong interest in German and European export control law, particularly AWG/AWV and the EU Dual-Use Regulation.
  • You enjoy explaining complex regulations in an understandable way and supporting your colleagues with solution-oriented approaches.
  • You work very carefully, in a structured manner, and independently.
  • You have fluent German language skills and very good English language skills.

NICE TO HAVE

Initial practical experience in export control, customs, compliance, or foreign trade, for example through internships or working student positions.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

title: Data Modeler

description: Project Role : Data Modeler Project Role Description : Work with key business representatives, data owners, end users, application designers and data architects to model current and new data. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Modeler, a typical day involves engaging closely with various stakeholders including business representatives, data owners, end users, application designers, and data architects. The role focuses on understanding existing data structures and designing new data models that align with business needs and technical requirements. This position requires continuous collaboration to ensure that data models are accurate, efficient, and support the organization's objectives. The Data Modeler plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between business goals and technical implementation by facilitating clear communication and thorough analysis of data requirements throughout the project lifecycle. Roles & Responsibilities: -Design and develop formal ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies using OWL, RDFS, and SKOS. - Elicit and model domain knowledge through structured interviews and workshops with subject-matter experts. - Integrate ontologies with knowledge graph infrastructure (e.g. Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog) and validate consistency using reasoners such as HermiT or Pellet. - Write and maintain SPARQL queries and SHACL/ShEx constraints to validate data conformance. - Align internal models with industry standards and open standards such as schema.org, Dublin Core, or domain-specific vocabularies. - Establish versioning, documentation, and governance practices for ontology lifecycle management. - Support downstream AI/ML teams by providing semantically enriched data for entity resolution, recommendation, and question-answering systems. - Required qualifications - Degree in computer science, information science, linguistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience) Hands-on experience with OWL 2, RDF, RDFS, and SKOS - Proficiency with Prot g or equivalent ontology authoring tools - Strong understanding of description logics and formal semantics - Scripting ability in Python for ontology processing and ETL tasks - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead the development and refinement of data models to ensure consistency and scalability. - Facilitate effective communication between technical teams and business stakeholders to align data strategies. - Mentor junior team members by providing guidance and support in data modeling best practices. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Graph Databases. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j. - Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts and methodologies specific to graph database technologies. - Ability to design and optimize complex data structures for performance and scalability. - Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical data models. - Familiarity with data integration and data governance principles to maintain data quality and compliance. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Graph Databases. - This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office. Education: - A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. Establish protocols to handle data, safeguard sensitive information, and optimize data usage within the organization. Design and advise on data quality rules and set up effective data compliance policies. Must have skills : Graph Databases Good to have skills : Neo4j, Python Frameworks Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Data Management Practitioner, a typical day involves overseeing the stewardship of an organization's data assets to ensure they meet quality and compliance standards. This role includes designing and implementing comprehensive data strategies that uphold data integrity and enforce governance policies. The practitioner establishes and maintains protocols for managing data securely, protecting sensitive information, and optimizing the use of data across various departments. Additionally, they provide guidance on data quality standards and develop effective compliance policies to support organizational objectives and regulatory requirements. Roles & Responsibilities: - Design and implement scalable ETL and ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured data into graph databases. - Build and maintain knowledge graph infrastructure on platforms such as Neo4j, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Apache Jena — including indexing, query optimization, and availability tuning. - Write and optimize complex SPARQL, Cypher, and Gremlin queries for production graph workloads including traversal, inference, and aggregation. - Implement SHACL or ShEx constraints and automated validation pipelines to enforce data conformance against ontology schemas. - Develop APIs and microservices that expose graph data to downstream consumers — including search, recommendation, and LLM/RAG pipelines. - Integrate knowledge graph layers with vector databases and embedding models to support hybrid semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation. - Collaborate with ontology designers to implement and version ontology changes safely in production without disrupting dependent services. - Monitor graph platform performance, diagnose bottlenecks, and drive reliability improvements across ingestion and query layers. - Conduct code reviews, define engineering standards, and mentor mid-level and junior developers on graph engineering best practices. - Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and internal tooling to support the broader knowledge graph team's productivity. - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead initiatives to improve data governance frameworks and ensure alignment with organizational goals. - Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to promote data quality and compliance. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Graph Databases, Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Neo4j, Python Frameworks. - Strong knowledge of data modeling and schema design specific to graph database technologies. - Ability to develop and optimize queries for efficient data retrieval and manipulation within graph databases. - Experience in implementing data governance policies and ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. - Familiarity with integrating graph databases into broader data ecosystems and workflows. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Graph Databases. - This position is based at our Bhubaneswar office. Capture and translate expert and unstructured knowledge into ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models, ensuring accuracy and context for automation and insights. Apply advanced analytics on knowledge graphs to drive problem-solving and actionable insights. Must have skills : Google Cloud Data Services Good to have skills : Microsoft Azure Data Services, Snowflake Data Warehouse Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: AI Powered Tech Talent You lead a significant knowledge engineering scope and function within a large program actively contribute to thought leadership. You shape how a substantial body of work formulates real-world problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, and set the technical direction for that scope. You lead a team and guide exploration and implementation of new methodologies, model building techniques, and cutting-edge algorithms. You remain at the forefront and drive innovation by applying these techniques to new business problems, use cases, and scenarios. You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, and establish the standards others follow. You justify the value to business and technology stakeholders, and construct the methodologies and data architectures that demonstrate it. You publish or present perspective beyond the immediate project. You work across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for their scope. Leads the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform a client's data architecture within program scope. Directs the design, development, and implementation of AI and semantic solutions, ensuring all the pieces work together seamlessly. Works with project leaders, delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create stand-out, graph-powered Data & AI offerings. Develops strong client relationships and earns the trust of key advisors. Makes the business case for the semantic layer solution recommended to the client. Contributes meaningfully to Accenture sales and pre-sales efforts. Provides thought leadership on technology trends, new opportunities, innovations, and foreseeable limitations, risks, and concerns. Bachelor's degree or equivalent Bachelor's degree or equivalent, plus at least 4 of the following: Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL) Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, and KG curation Minimum 3 years of designing and developing KG solutions and graph-based ML models (functional + technical) Minimum 2 years of experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementations for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration Minimum 4 years of experience with strong knowledge of relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases Minimum 2 years of experience in leading a team or workstream within a larger program 2+ years of hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) 2+ years of experience in Python, with experience in frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, and tools for building ETL pipelines (e.g. Apache NiFi, Airflow) Practical experience with NLP and/or Search techniques Prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications. You have team lead experience Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones. You have external client-facing consulting experience Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems. As a Knowledge Engineer, your typical day involves designing and structuring comprehensive knowledge frameworks that empower artificial intelligence systems to reason effectively and make well-informed decisions. You will focus on capturing expert knowledge and transforming unstructured information into organized ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models. Your work ensures that the knowledge representations maintain accuracy and contextual relevance, supporting automation and generating valuable insights. Additionally, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to these knowledge structures to facilitate problem-solving and deliver actionable intelligence across various domains. Roles & Responsibilities: - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead the development and refinement of knowledge representation models to enhance system reasoning capabilities. - Facilitate knowledge sharing and alignment across cross-functional teams to ensure consistency and integration. - Mentor junior team members by providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Google Cloud Data Services. - Good To Have Skills: Experience with Microsoft Azure Data Services, Snowflake Data Warehouse. - Strong expertise in designing and implementing ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic models. - Experience in applying advanced analytics techniques to knowledge-based data structures. - Ability to work with unstructured data and transform it into structured, machine-readable formats. - Familiarity with cloud-based data management and processing platforms. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Google Cloud Data Services. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, military veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Develop reusable, extensible data models supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML feature engineering, and decision science use cases. Apply semantic modeling techniques, including domain modeling, entity relationships, hierarchies, and taxonomies. Enable ontology and knowledge graph modeling, translating subject-matter knowledge into machine-readable representations. Ensure alignment of data models with enterprise architecture principles, data standards, and best practices. Enable explainability, reasoning, and contextual grounding through ontology-driven approaches and graph-based data models. Partner with data science and AI teams to ensure models support feature reuse, RAG pipelines, and intelligent agent workflows. Contribute to data model designs that improve trust, interpretability, and scalability of AI-driven solutions. Data Governance & Standards Follow and contribute to data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design guidelines across projects. Support data governance initiatives including metadata management, lineage, and documentation. Ensure consistency, quality, and reusability of data assets across platforms and use cases. Business Impact and Innovation Translate complex business concepts into clear, well-structured data models that accelerate analytics and AI adoption. Enable faster solution development by providing high-quality, well-documented data foundations. Support measurable outcomes by improving data usability, consistency, and decision-making effectiveness. Experience designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models. Experience working in consulting or client-facing roles is highly preferred. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills Strong expertise in data modeling techniques and methodologies. Proficiency with data modeling tools (ER modeling tools, UML, or equivalent) is preferred. Experience working with relational and graph-based data models. Familiarity with semantic modeling concepts, ontologies, or knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/OWL concepts). Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Preferred Skills Exposure to knowledge graph technologies (e.g., Neo4j or similar). Familiarity with AI/ML and GenAI consumption patterns, including feature stores, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems. Experience defining data standards and governance frameworks. Prior experience supporting analytics, decision science, or AI-driven initiatives. You own how the most demanding programs formulate real-world problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, setting strategy and architecture end to end. You lead and develop teams of engineers, building capability across the discipline and guiding adoption of new methods and algorithms. You define what staying at the forefront means for the practice; drive innovation and translate it into new offerings. You set the standards for how ontologies are designed, evaluated, and maintained across programs. You make the case to senior stakeholders and shape the methodologies and data architectures that prove value at scale. You lead the creation of thought leadership, innovation, and reusable assets that advance the discipline beyond any single engagement. You partner with business and technical leaders to direct end-to-end delivery across complex, multi-stakeholder programs. THE WORK Lead the complete Knowledge Graph solution scope that transforms data architecture for our most strategic and complex clients. Own the design, development, and implementation of AI and semantic solutions across the program. Partner with project leaders, delivery leads, and senior client stakeholders to create stand-out, graph-powered offerings. Develop trusted-advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders. Make and defend the business case for the semantic layer solution at the executive level. Lead Accenture sales and pre-sales efforts and shape data transformation programs. Drive the practice's thought leadership, innovation, and asset development on trends and agentic technologies, and develop the teams who deliver them. BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION Bachelor's degree or equivalent, plus all of the following: Significant experience with Knowledge Graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL) Advanced practical knowledge of schema design, ontology management, and KG curation Seasoned in designing and developing KG solutions and graph-based ML models (functional + technical) Proven experience in end-to-end data pipeline implementations for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration Extensive experience with strong knowledge of relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases Managerial experience leading people, able to explain the value of the semantic layer and knowledge graphs to senior business and technology stakeholders, with a proven track record in sales and/or pre-sales and in delivering data transformation programs and developing teams PREFERRED QUALIFICATION Experience in Practical experience with NLP techniques and/or Search Techniques, prompt engineering Experience with LLMs for enterprise-scale applications. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) Well-versed in Python, with experience in frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, and tools for building ETL pipelines (e.g. Apache NiFi, Airflow) Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones. description: #LI-FBL VOUS ÊTES Vous êtes un solide contributeur individuel en ingénierie des connaissances évoluant vers un rôle de chef d'équipe. Vous maîtrisez l'ensemble du cycle de vie du développement des graphes de connaissances. Vous transformez des problèmes du monde réel en solutions pratiques, efficaces et évolutives basées sur l'IA et les graphes de connaissances, en travaillant de manière opérationnelle sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie, de l'ingestion à la modélisation, la curation et le déploiement. Vous appliquez les méthodologies, techniques et algorithmes actuels avec l'architecture appropriée et commencez à guider les ingénieurs juniors sur le projet. Vous restez à jour sur l'ingénierie des connaissances, l'IA générative, les LLM et les modèles multimodaux ; vous recherchez les opportunités de les appliquer au problème traité. Vous concevez, évaluez et maintenez les ontologies lorsque cela est nécessaire. Vous contribuez à démontrer la valeur des approches basées sur l'IA générative et les graphes de connaissances pour un problème métier donné. Vous partagez vos apprentissages avec l'équipe. Vous collaborez avec les utilisateurs, les représentants des cas d'usage, les ingénieurs, les architectes et les concepteurs UI afin de fournir votre contribution à une solution de bout en bout. LE TRAVAIL Construire des composants de graphe de connaissances qui contribuent à la transformation de l'architecture de données d'un client. Concevoir, développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'IA et des solutions sémantiques ; veiller à ce que votre travail s'intègre proprement au système global. Travailler aux côtés de l'équipe projet et des responsables de delivery. Établir de solides relations de travail avec les interlocuteurs clients de votre domaine d'activité. Aider à rassembler les éléments justificatifs soutenant la solution de couche sémantique recommandée. Soutenir les efforts commerciaux d'Accenture lorsque cela est demandé. Continuer à développer vos compétences dans les solutions Data & AI de pointe, en particulier les technologies agentiques, et partager ces connaissances avec l'équipe. title: Responsable de l’ingénierie des connaissances

description: UKI Finance RP Finance Data Engineer The practice Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role. Purpose of the role Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence. Responsibilities Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning. Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate. Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings. Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations. Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation. Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role- or attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging. Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support. Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership. Data engineering Essential experience Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial. Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies. Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls. Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns. Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer – desirable) Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data. Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria. At least 10 years’ relevant professional experience Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG. Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog. Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments. Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud. Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking. You will closely work with our team of senior scientists and systems engineers in our knowledge intelligence team, which is leading the full lifecycle of graph-based AI solutions, from customer problem formulation and ontology design to production deployment, enabling network-wide data discovery, decision support, and compliance monitoring. A core part of your mandate is to lead the semantic modelling and ontological foundation layer that supports both explainability and retrieval capabilities. This foundation feeds into transversal initiatives spanning multiple teams and products involving multiple AI approaches. design, build, and deploy graph-based AI solutions that combine knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and ML models to extract meaning from large-scale unstructured document collections, enabling data discovery, classification, and governance across RME • define and own knowledge pipelines that extract, transform, and enrich entity relationships from diverse unstructured and semi-structured sources into production-grade knowledge graphs, ensuring reliability and accuracy of the overall information architecture • collaborate with fellow senior scientists to design, deploy, and operate graph and vector databases to support retrieval, causal reasoning, and analytics use case as well as ensure contributing scientists maintain versioning, validation state, and provenance systems can leverage the semantic layer with minimal impedance mismatch • integrate LLMs and ML models into text processing pipelines for classification, embedding generation, document similarity, entity extraction, and semantic analysis, applying rigorous experimentation and evaluation methodology to select the best fit-for purpose approach • design ontological structures that support explainability, enabling agents and reasoning systems to trace reasoning paths and surface provenance, enabling governance-level transparency for autonomous AI actions • optimize models and inference pipelines for production constraints including latency, throughput, cost, and infrastructure reliability • establish best practices and standards for knowledge engineering and applied science processes, elevating the maturity of RME's data, information, and AI capabilities • mentor and train colleagues on knowledge graph concepts, semantic modelling, and applied AI techniques About the Within six months, you will deliver an automated triage workflow that matches requests to capabilities and produces draft, rubric-based recommendations to reduce turnaround time. Maintain and improve the domain capability taxonomy, ensuring capabilities are current, clearly described, and consistently classified. Identify capability gaps between platform offerings and engineering demand, and translate gaps into structured inputs for the platform roadmap. Apply a rubric-based assessment method consistently, producing documented, defensible recommendations and decision records. Design and maintain a governed, queryable knowledge base covering capability definitions, assessment history, decision records, and platform non-functional requirements. Implement RAG pipelines over authoritative documentation to deliver accurate, citation-backed responses for engineers and stakeholders. Develop agentic evaluation workflows that retrieve relevant capabilities and prior assessments, draft preliminary recommendations, and score requests against the rubric. Build and maintain natural-language query experiences that help users understand capabilities, preferences, and outcomes with governed responses. Instrument governance and assessment workflows with measurable metrics (for example, throughput, coverage, and taxonomy drift) and publish reporting for governance stakeholders. Create proofs of concept when needed to validate assessments and demonstrate whether requests align to existing services or require new capability investment. Seven or more years of relevant experience in technology governance, architecture review, or platform engineering within a large enterprise environment. Proficiency in Python and experience building production-quality automation, evaluation pipelines, or workflow services. Experience designing and building knowledge bases and RAG solutions, including chunking strategies, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and grounded response generation. description: Job summary As a Senior Principal Data Architect at JPMorganChase within the IAM - Data Services Organization, you provide specialized expertise to influence the target state architecture and strategy. Work across teams to implement and advance the adoption of complex, strategic, global data architecture solutions that will give JPMorganChase a competitive advantage. You will build a Data Services platform that connects scattered assurance data into one governed model. That model runs from control objectives through to evidence, findings and verified closure. In 2027 it will prove few use cases on a shared data foundation and semantic model before scaling firmwide . We're looking for an architect who has designed, built and operated semantic models for large-scale applications. You will own the enterprise semantic model at the center of this platform. Job responsibilities Own the design of the enterprise semantic model. This means stable entity identities, typed relationships, constraints and versioning across the chain Control Objective → Procedure → Application → Platform → Evidence → Finding → Closure. Set and enforce firmwide standards for modelling, identity resolution, taxonomy and ontology. Work with function SMEs (for example IGA and PAM) to register domain taxonomies against a common core. Decide when to use graph-native processing and when to use lakehouse/SQL processing, for traversal, impact analysis and graph analytics at scale. Design how the semantic layer fits with the data lakehouse (Databricks bronze, silver and gold layers). That includes how gold contracts feed the graph and how lineage and provenance carry through. Define data contract and schema evolution patterns so changes never surprise consumers. Build point-in-time history into the model so audit evidence packs can be reproduced, and separate configuration evidence from operating evidence. Make sure every output carries entitlements, data minimization and quality state (freshness, coverage, completeness, and whether a value was observed, inferred or derived). This applies to dashboards, APIs, data shares and conversational access. Design deterministic, auditable context for AI agents, with clear control boundaries and human approval checkpoints. Guide producer teams on silver and gold modelling and contract design, and deliver the 2027 proof points. Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to senior technology, Risk and Audit stakeholders. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills A proven record of designing, building and operating semantic models or knowledge graphs for large-scale enterprise applications: many source systems, high-volume entities and relationships, and multiple consuming applications in production. Deep expertise in graph and semantic data modelling, covering entity and relationship design, ontology and taxonomy design, identity and entity resolution, constraint design, and temporal or bitemporal (point-in-time) modelling. Hands-on experience with graph technologies and query languages, such as a property graph or RDF/OWL. You understand where recursive SQL breaks down for traversal, cycles and graph analytics. Strong cloud-native data platform architecture experience, ideally on Databricks or another lakehouse with a bronze/silver/gold (medallion) layout. You can design how a lakehouse and a semantic layer work together. Experience setting and running data contracts, schema versioning and change management across many producer teams. A proven record of setting data modelling standards across many teams and products, and of influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority. Experience with lineage, provenance, data quality and completeness, and entitlement-aware access, including handling sensitive data (for example CCI) at the source. Experience leading safe adoption of firm-approved AI capabilities in data architecture workflows, including validation practices and awareness of data sensitivity. The ability to evaluate and govern AI-enabled architecture patterns, including agentic workflows, with clear control boundaries, auditability and human approval checkpoints aligned to resiliency and security expectations. The ability to evaluate current and emerging technologies and recommend data architecture approaches that reach the target architecture. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience modelling controls, risk, audit or compliance data, such as control-to-evidence mapping, findings and remediation workflows, or continuous control monitoring. Familiarity with identity and access management data (IGA, PAM, entitlements, privileged access). Experience with metadata management, data catalogues, MDM, and lineage or provenance at enterprise scale. AI/ML enablement through graphs (feature generation, embeddings, relationship-aware retrieval or GraphRAG), with strong grounding in data controls. Experience building self-service data platforms (YAML/SQL-declared pipelines, automated deploys, guardrails, quotas and budgets). Experience at a regulated financial institution.
